description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'autoencoder_logreg' baseline: TF-IDF word featurizer compressed via a sklearn MLP autoencoder bottleneck + Logistic Regression.
model: autoencoder_logreg (TF-IDF word featurizer compressed via a sklearn MLP autoencoder bottleneck + Logistic Regression)
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'autoencoder_logreg', group(s): reduced_dim); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate. The arena measures which sklearn recipe wins on assistant-style templates, not which fighter 'is' jurebes.
